_comment: Live SundaeSwap V4 CBOR captured from the 2026-09-07 audit-final deployments (preview via db-sync, preprod via Koios). Inline datums and redeemers are verbatim on-chain bytes; every class round-trips them byte-exact. Derivation facts (pool identifier from the seed output reference, module_state hash from the module config) are recorded next to their inputs.

legacy_june_2026_preview._comment: Encodings from the superseded June-2026 preview deployment whose shapes the audit did not change: a scoop transcript entry carrying a tag-5 bounty claim (operation_data = BountyClaim{asset, amount}) and a swap-role order (SwapConstraint, constructor 2). The swap role is not part of the deployed launch packages; these bytes only pin the parsers' shapes.
